name: Innerverse
source:
Ava is struggling with her identity, depression, and lately, insomnia has been keeping her awake at night. Find out what's keeping her awake, and hopefully she'll finally be able to get a good night's rest.

[From [url=https://sammy-lammy.itch.io/innerverse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾娃正為自我認同與憂鬱所困，最近又因失眠而夜夜難以入睡。找出究竟是什麼讓她無法成眠，希望她終於能夠好好睡上一覺。

[摘自[url=https://sammy-lammy.itch.io/innerverse]itch.io[/url]]
